core_obligations: Given the cited multi-scale compactification/period-coordinate and minimal-stratum counting inputs, the remaining author problem is to construct and control the canonical differential on the entire compactified generic two-zero fiber. The proof classifies the vertical and horizontal degenerations, combines prong-matching multiplicities with logarithmic-period asymptotics to determine every pole order/residue, excludes finite cylinders via the relative-period flow and a persistent shortest-transverse-saddle argument, and uses decorated real graphs plus a GL2 degeneration to force every saddle-connection period to be a partial residue sum. Those geometric/dynamical controls yield the nondegeneration and common stratum-component assertions; they are not supplied by formally differentiating a local period. Count complete Theorem1.2 with its section3/4 proof development as one H3 result,not the short final summary or its many local helpers.
